name: Langdock
what: Model-agnostic enterprise AI platform (chat, agents, workflows, integrations, API) that lets companies deploy LLMs across their workforce without vendor lock-in.
homonym_note: The General Catalyst sibling notes that Google News hits for 'Langdock' sometimes name other companies; the Berlin enterprise-AI company (YC S23) is this one.

membership.basis: Listed on the live visionaries.vc portfolio (companies-2026). It was not on the archived visionaries.vc/portfolio page as of the 2025-10-14 capture, so the position was added after Oct 2025. No round announcement names Visionaries.
membership.quote: Langdock – Building the model agnostic AI platform for enterprises

status.event: Reverse flip: US (Delaware) parent replaced by a German SE, reported Sept 2026 (not a change of control)

graduation_surfaces: googlenews: "Langdock" and "Langdock" raises -> only the April 2024 $3M seed (TechCrunch); 2025-2026 items are ARR milestones (Dealroom notes, not used), the Sept 2026 reverse flip, founder angel checks into Zero
WebSearch (1 call): 'Langdock funding round 2026 Visionaries investors Series A' -> vendor profiles only (Tracxn, PitchBook, Crunchbase, Sacra); no announced round after the 2024 seed
notes: Entry undetermined: TechCrunch's seed report (2024-04-19) names General Catalyst and La Famiglia plus unnamed German founders/operators, not Visionaries; Euronews (2026-09-16) names only Y Combinator and says 'About 80% of Langdock is owned by founders and employees who live in the EU'. Visionaries appeared on its site only after Oct 2025, while Langdock grew from $1M ARR (Oct 2024) to a $50M run rate (Aug 2026), so the position is likely a late, unannounced primary or secondary purchase; a pre-2025 personal angel check by a Visionaries partner at the seed cannot be excluded and would not be a fund position. Vendor profiles (WebSearch) list Visionaries Club as an investor without a round. Graduation 'n/a' because no entry round is established. Agrees with both siblings on Berlin and AI & Applied AI.
